credits.title: Peaked
credits.overview: The two girls who traumatized you in high school try to relive their glory days at their 10-year reunion.

credits.title: The Debut
credits.overview: When Mona Friedman is cast in a bit part at a small community theater, she transforms from a shy, unassuming housewife into a zealous method actor willing to do anything to protect the artistic integrity of her marginal role—even if it means waging war against the show’s domineering director.

credits.title: Club Kid
credits.overview: A hard-partying New York City club promoter sees his whirlwind lifestyle upended by the arrival of the 10-year-old son he never knew he had.
